the proposed method provides an easy and efficient way to use deep convolutional networks in image retrieval tasks, and it outperforms the state-of-the- art by a considerable margin on four commonly used benchmarks.
deep convolutional features can be used as a drop-in replacement for traditional hand-engineered local features in many applications.
